insert into sys_user (account, employee_no, name, mobile, dept_code, dept_name, dept_path, position_name, job_grade, entry_date, status, password, source, last_sync_time) values
(#{user.account}, #{user.employeeNo}, #{user.name}, #{user.mobile}, #{user.deptCode}, #{user.deptName}, #{user.deptPath}, #{user.positionName}, #{user.jobGrade}, #{user.entryDate}, #{user.status}, #{user.password}, #{user.source}, #{user.lastSyncTime})
as incoming on duplicate key update employee_no = incoming.employee_no, name = incoming.name, mobile = incoming.mobile, dept_code = incoming.dept_code, dept_name = incoming.dept_name, dept_path = incoming.dept_path, position_name = incoming.position_name, job_grade = incoming.job_grade, entry_date = incoming.entry_date, last_sync_time = incoming.last_sync_time
